displayIdentity.body: Worldly wisdom yields because all things belong to them. Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise. and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
displayIdentity.title: Worldly wisdom yields because all things belong to them
